DLP Notification Template Resource Get Template By ID
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/dlpNotificationTemplates/:templateId

Gets DLP notification template information for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
templateId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifer for the DLP notification template.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

The unique identifier for a DLP notification template.

name
string
REQUIRED

The DLP notification template name.

subject
string
REQUIRED

The Subject line that is displayed within the DLP notification email.

attachContent
boolean

If set to true, the content that is violation is attached to the DLP notification email.

plainTextMessage
string
REQUIRED

The template for the plain text UTF-8 message body that must be displayed in the DLP notification email.

htmlMessage
string
REQUIRED

The template for the HTML message body that must be displayed in the DLP notification email.
